approved_source.onepager: 51. Returns and Complaints Resolution Agent one-pager 2026 02 23.pptx

routing.finding: Return review, classification, option drafting, and trend analysis each have a locked case.

interface_schema.finding: Service, quality, and loss-prevention personas are explicit and identifiers are validated.

behavior.finding: Named customers were replaced with anonymous cases and execution steps were rewritten as approval-gated review steps.

safety.finding: No return, refund, credit, replacement, shipment, reservation, account change, or message is performed.

fixes: Aligned to the demo video: synthetic case CMP-5001 (David Chen, Diamond VIP, $18,400 LTV, ProBook laptop) with six new operations (escalation_snapshot, recovery_tiers with computed $540 cost and 34:1 ROI, resolution_execution_plan ready for authorized execution, follow_up_plan, recovery_performance with $4.67M net program value, executive_summary); Service Manager persona; calendar-correct day counts; trend insight computed from data. Nothing is dispatched, credited, scheduled or sent.
alignment_findings: Collateral alignment (demo video + one-pager): the agent covered anonymous returns only; the video's escalated VIP complaint (customer profile, value-based recovery tiers, execution plan with talking points, follow-up plan, recovery performance, executive summary) was missing; days-since-purchase used 30-day months and the trend insight claimed an 8% improvement the data does not show.
